topic: PlacementExplanation and SpaceInfo still lack public_paths fields (rest of RC-800)
detail: SP-053's editor reads each space's public_paths from DiffSpaces' policy document, so it needs no SpaceInfo field, and its tester shows the matched public_paths pattern only inside ExplainPlacement's reason text. Adding public_path to PlacementExplanation and public_paths to SpaceInfo needs field numbers on existing messages, which a lane may not take without the coordinator's block. When one is given, add the fields and show the pattern as its own line in the tester and the Settings validator.
